mapper.sql: s.id, s.student_id, s.indicator_id, s.academic_term, s.score, s.source, s.evidence, s.scorer_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at, i.code AS indicator_code, i.name AS indicator_name, i.dimension, i.max_score, i.weight, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(sc.real_name, ''), sc.username) AS scorer_name

FROM eval_score s LEFT JOIN eval_indicator i ON i.id = s.indicator_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = s.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users sc ON sc.id = s.scorer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_score (student_id, indicator_id, academic_term, score, source, evidence, scorer_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{indicatorId}, #{academicTerm}, #{score}, #{source}, #{evidence}, #{scorerId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), evidence = VALUES(evidence), scorer_id = VALUES(scorer_id), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM eval_score WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND academic_term = #{term} AND source = #{source}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT academic_term FROM eval_score ORDER BY academic_term DESC
